requirements_summary: Workload: internal IT/helpdesk chat agent; high-throughput during morning support window
Primary features: streaming responses, tool calling (ticket lookup + action triggers), structured output for agent UI
Latency target: p95 end-to-end <= 300ms for streaming first bytes; p50 ~150ms
Throughput: expected steady 30-50 concurrent agent sessions, peak 150 concurrent during incidents
Cost sensitivity: mid-market; prefer Hosted for quick rollout but consider Dedicated if TCO improves >30%
Security: SSO/SAML, KMS integration, configurable retention (90-365 days), audit logs exported to SIEM
Routing/fallback: prefer automatic fallback to smaller compatible model under capacity constraints
Integration: Zendesk + internal ticket system via tool-calling REST hooks, webhook-based eventing
